hyperedges.label: Electron Layered Architecture (renderer -> preload -> main -> runner -> engine)
Job Safety Guards (main process as source of truth)

nodes.label: Header Pill Navigation
nodes.rationale: Fixed header with pill nav (Beranda + four tools), sliding purple indicator using a Motion spring; collapses to icons below 1120px.

nodes.label: Beranda Landing Page
nodes.rationale: Landing-page style home: floating PDF->XLSX->CSV hero cards, feature chips, bento tool cards, lavender 'Kenapa ExpCore?' panel, CTA banner, navy footer; staggered reveal on scroll into view.

nodes.label: Keyboard Shortcuts
nodes.rationale: Tab focus ring, Ctrl+O choose folder, Alt+0 home, Alt+1-4 tools, Page Up/Down page scroll outside text fields and log.

nodes.label: Motion for JavaScript
nodes.rationale: Vanilla Framer Motion equivalent, used for home/tool entrance, floating hero cards, nav indicator, status pill and update banner; hover/focus use Tailwind CSS transitions.

nodes.label: Python Test Suite (test_expcore.py)
nodes.rationale: Covers parser, naming, three-module export, subfolders, batch continuation on corrupt PDF, and engine protocol on synthetic PDFs; --pdf-samples checks 151 local PDFs read-only.

nodes.label: Status Pill & Progress Bar
nodes.rationale: Per-state colored pill with pop animation; determinate gradient bar or indeterminate shimmer.

nodes.label: Tool Page Layout
nodes.rationale: Header, card 01 document source, card 02 activity & results, sticky action bar; each tool keeps its own folder, activity and results for the session.

nodes.label: Update Banner
nodes.rationale: Spring-animated banner below the header that does not cover content.

nodes.label: Verification Results (8 Oct 2026)
nodes.rationale: Parser output identical to v2.0.1 on 151 real BPBS PDFs (12/12, repeated 3x); dev 27/27 and packaged 31 pass + 1 skipped at 100/125/150%; real Windows 11 installer install/upgrade/uninstall verified; test resilience to minimized windows via interval polling.

nodes.label: ExpCore Desktop Workspace Design
nodes.rationale: Bright, soft modern SaaS visual language (bluish-white canvas, purple accent, lavender panels, rounded white cards, Inter). Motion is used sparingly so the UI feels alive without disrupting document work.

nodes.label: Text-based Status Labels & Contrast
nodes.rationale: Statuses are always text (MENUNGGU FOLDER, SIAP DIPROSES, MEMPROSES, SELESAI, TIDAK ADA HASIL, PERLU DIPERIKSA) so color is never the only differentiator; ink-soft 8:1, ink-muted 4.9:1, white on brand-600 4.7:1.

nodes.label: Log Mouse-Wheel Forwarding
nodes.rationale: At log edges the mouse wheel is explicitly forwarded to the page because native scroll chaining is inconsistent at fractional DPI (125%/150%).

nodes.label: Reduced Motion Support
nodes.rationale: When Windows prefers-reduced-motion is on, all Motion and CSS animations are disabled and content shows fully; initial entrance state is set in CSS to avoid a flash before scripts run.

nodes.label: build:renderer Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Tailwind CLI (src/styles.css -> dist/styles.css) and esbuild (src/app.js -> dist/app.js plus Inter font); run automatically by npm start, npm test and build_release.py; src/ is not packaged.

nodes.label: Inter Variable Font
nodes.rationale: Bundled locally (not fetched), with Segoe UI fallback.

nodes.label: Preload Bridge (window.expcore)
nodes.rationale: The only bridge between renderer and main.

nodes.label: Reicon Icons
nodes.rationale: <span data-icon> placeholders replaced by SVG on load; decorative icons are aria-hidden and use currentColor.

nodes.label: Renderer Layer
nodes.rationale: index.html + src/ bundled to dist/; no Node access (sandbox, contextIsolation).

nodes.label: Strict Content-Security-Policy
nodes.rationale: Renderer loads only local files, no inline script/style, no eval; navigation, new windows, webviews and device permissions denied; menu and DevTools unavailable in installed app.

nodes.label: Visual Tokens (@theme)
nodes.rationale: All tokens defined once in the @theme block of app/renderer/src/styles.css and consumed as Tailwind classes (brand-600 #6d5bf7, ink, ink-soft, line, canvas, navy; card radius 24px, control 12px).

nodes.label: Folder Path Field
nodes.rationale: Path can be typed, pasted from Explorer 'Copy as path' (quoted, cleaned by main), or picked via native dialog.

nodes.label: Inline Results
nodes.rationale: Finished results shown inline with open Excel/CSV and copy-log buttons; changing the folder invalidates stale result links and preview status.

nodes.label: Electron Main Process
nodes.rationale: Owns window, native dialogs, IPC validation, job state and updates.

nodes.label: DPI-aware Window Sizing
nodes.rationale: Initial size adapts to screen and DPI; minimum 960x620 logical px.

nodes.label: Job Locking & Busy Navigation
nodes.rationale: Folder/processing controls lock during a job while navigation stays active; busy tool marked with pulsing dot (aria-busy). The Electron main process is the source of truth for job state.

nodes.label: Native Confirmation Dialogs
nodes.rationale: Replacing a recap or applying names needs native confirmation with an action-named button and Batal as default; closing the app or installing an update while a job runs is deferred until results and log are written (prevents data loss).

nodes.label: Rename Preview Gate
nodes.rationale: Apply-rename requires a completed preview; enforced both in renderer controls and by main rejecting apply for folders without a preview (defense in depth).

nodes.label: npm test E2E Suite
nodes.rationale: Runner contract + Electron/engine E2E (navigation, responsive layout, icons, fonts, wheel, keyboard, four tools, confirmation, locking, entrance animation, reduced motion, renderer isolation, single instance); EXPCORE_SCALE and EXPCORE_APP variants; failures save screenshots and UI state to %TEMP%\expcore-e2e-artefak.

nodes.label: Engine Runner
nodes.rationale: app/engine.js runs the engine and reads the per-line JSON protocol.

nodes.label: Python Engine (expcore_engine -> ExpCore)
nodes.rationale: PDF parser and Excel/CSV export, one process per job.

nodes.label: Disclaimer of Warranty and Limitation of Liability (Sections 7-8)
nodes.rationale: Work is provided AS IS with no warranties and no contributor liability, which is what makes an unpaid tax-document parser distributable at all.
nodes.norm_label: disclaimer of warranty and limitation of liability (sections 7-8)

nodes.label: Grant of Patent License (Section 3)
nodes.rationale: Patent grant terminates if the licensee files patent litigation over the Work, a defensive-termination trade-off in exchange for the irrevocable royalty-free grant.

nodes.label: Redistribution Conditions (Section 4)
nodes.rationale: Redistribution requires shipping the license, marking modified files, retaining attribution notices, and propagating any NOTICE file.

nodes.label: Non-standard appendix note about Eclipse Public License
nodes.rationale: The appendix contains a sentence not present in the canonical Apache 2.0 text, advising also obtaining an 'Eclipse Public License' if hosting the code. Provenance and intent unclear; flagged for review.
nodes.norm_label: non-standard appendix note about eclipse public license

nodes.label: Bukti Potong 2024 (BPBS pra-Coretax)
nodes.rationale: Reads pre-Coretax FORMULIR BPBS (sections H.1-H.5) with its own parser.

nodes.label: Bukti Potong 2026 (BPPU Coretax)
nodes.rationale: Reads Coretax BPPU form (sections B.3-B.11); separate parser from 2024 module because the forms differ and do not replace each other.

nodes.label: Output Excel Terformat
nodes.rationale: Single Excel per run with number formats, auto column width and Folder Sumber column to trace PDFs merged from subfolders; existing file replaced only after user confirmation.

nodes.label: BPBS Tarif Format Parsing
nodes.rationale: Tarif written as 2, 2.00 or 2,00 all read as 2%; integer form previously caused nine files to be missed.

nodes.label: Penamaan Otomatis Bupot
nodes.rationale: Name taken only from C.3 Nama Pemotong; if C.3 empty the PDF is skipped instead of falling back to receiver name. Existing names never overwritten (suffix (2)). Preview-before-apply, and apply rescans the folder so changes since preview are rechecked.

nodes.label: Format Mismatch Skip
nodes.rationale: Choosing the wrong Bukti Potong menu does not damage data; non-matching PDFs are skipped and logged.

nodes.label: BPBS Sifat Checkbox Rule
nodes.rationale: Sifat read from X mark on H.4/H.5; if not exactly one box checked the column is '-' rather than guessing.

nodes.label: Auto Update (electron-updater)
nodes.rationale: Checks latest stable GitHub release after window opens; download/install only with user consent, SHA-512 verified from latest.yml, install held while PDF job runs, silent on network errors, no token and no user data sent.

nodes.label: Electron E2E Tests (npm test)
nodes.rationale: Real app window with stubbed native dialogs and synthetic fixtures; rerun at 125%/150% scale (EXPCORE_SCALE) and against packaged app (EXPCORE_APP) with local update server.

nodes.label: GitHub Release Publishing
nodes.rationale: Tag v+version; upload Setup exe, blockmap and latest.yml (without latest.yml no update is offered).

nodes.label: Renderer Build (Tailwind CLI + esbuild)
nodes.rationale: app/renderer/src is built into app/renderer/dist via npm run build:renderer; run automatically by npm start, npm test and build_release.py so the app stays offline.

nodes.label: Local-only Processing
nodes.rationale: PDFs and extraction results are never sent to the internet; renderer assets are bundled so the app works fully offline.

nodes.label: Engine JSON-per-line Protocol
nodes.rationale: Each job spawns one Python engine process emitting log/progress/result as JSON lines, keeping extraction logic in ExpCore.py independent of the UI.

nodes.label: NSIS Installer (electron-builder)
nodes.rationale: Per-machine install to Program Files (admin); unsigned so SmartScreen may warn.

nodes.label: Nuitka Engine Build
nodes.rationale: Nuitka bundles from the interpreter running it; missing modules only warn and yield a broken exe, so build uses the explicit venv path and smoke-tests the built engine on synthetic PDFs for all four tools.

nodes.label: Explicit .venv Python Path Rule
nodes.rationale: Bare `python` follows PATH and may hit another interpreter; calling ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe explicitly prevents most build problems.

nodes.label: Forward-slash Path Rule
nodes.rationale: Forward slashes work in both PowerShell and Git Bash; backslashes are escape chars in Git Bash and break the venv path.

nodes.label: ExpCore 2.x Uninstall Requirement
nodes.rationale: 3.x installer does not remove 2.x; without manual uninstall there are two entries and removing the old one afterwards can break 3.x in the same folder.
